import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import Polygon, FancyArrowPatch
mpl.rcParams.update({ "text.usetex": False, "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "font.size": 11, "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "text.color": "#263238", "svg.fonttype": "path", })
BLUE = "#33658A" GREEN = "#6B8E5E" RED = "#C4524C" SLATE = "#657786" INK = "#263238"
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5)) ax = fig.add_axes([0, 0, 1, 1]) ax.set_xlim(0, 8) ax.set_ylim(0, 5) ax.set_aspect("equal") ax.axis("off")
# Illustrative dimensionless vectors, not experimental measurements. a = np.array([1.45, 0.0, 0.0]) b = np.array([0.35, 1.10, 0.0]) c = np.cross(a, b)
theta = np.deg2rad(35) R = np.array([ [np.cos(theta), 0, np.sin(theta)], [0, 1, 0], [-np.sin(theta), 0, np.cos(theta)], ]) assert np.allclose(R.T @ R, np.eye(3)) assert np.isclose(np.linalg.det(R), 1) assert np.allclose(np.cross(R @ a, R @ b), R @ c)
# A common orthographic camera for both configurations. projection = np.array([ [np.sqrt(3) / 2, -0.5, 0], [0.25, np.sqrt(3) / 4, np.sqrt(3) / 2], ])
def project(v, origin): return np.asarray(origin) + projection @ v
def vector_arrow(origin, vector, color): end = project(vector, origin) ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch( origin, end, arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=16, linewidth=2.4, color=color, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0, zorder=5, )) return end
def right_angle(origin, normal, tangent): # These markers are squares in their respective 3D vector planes. n = normal / np.linalg.norm(normal) t = tangent / np.linalg.norm(tangent) d = 0.17 points = np.array([ project(d * n, origin), project(d * (n + t), origin), project(d * t, origin), ]) ax.plot(points[:, 0], points[:, 1], color=SLATE, linewidth=1.0, zorder=6)
def label_at(point, text, offset, color, ha="left", va="center"): ax.annotate( text, point, xytext=offset, textcoords="offset points", ha=ha, va=va, fontsize=16, color=color, zorder=8, )
def configuration(origin, va, vb, vc, rotated=False): corners = np.array([ project(np.zeros(3), origin), project(va, origin), project(va + vb, origin), project(vb, origin), ]) ax.add_patch(Polygon( corners, closed=True, facecolor=BLUE, alpha=0.10, edgecolor="none", zorder=1, )) # The two far edges complete the parallelogram without competing # with the vector arrows. far = corners[[1, 2, 3]] ax.plot(far[:, 0], far[:, 1], color=SLATE, linewidth=1.15, linestyle=(0, (4, 3)), alpha=0.65, zorder=2)
pa = vector_arrow(origin, va, BLUE) pb = vector_arrow(origin, vb, GREEN) pc = vector_arrow(origin, vc, RED) right_angle(origin, vc, va) right_angle(origin, vc, vb) ax.plot(*origin, marker="o", markersize=3.4, color=INK, zorder=7)
if rotated: label_at(pa, r"$R\mathbf{a}$", (8, -3), BLUE) label_at(pb, r"$R\mathbf{b}$", (-9, 5), GREEN, ha="right") label_at(pc, r"$R(\mathbf{a}\times\mathbf{b})$", (0, 12), RED, ha="center") else: label_at(pa, r"$\mathbf{a}$", (8, -1), BLUE) label_at(pb, r"$\mathbf{b}$", (-9, 4), GREEN, ha="right") label_at(pc, r"$\mathbf{a}\times\mathbf{b}$", (-10, 7), RED, ha="right")
configuration((1.85, 1.60), a, b, c) configuration((5.55, 1.85), R @ a, R @ b, R @ c, rotated=True)
ax.text(4, 4.72, "Rotation equivariance of the cross product", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=16, weight="medium") ax.text( 4, 4.23, r"$(R\mathbf{a})\times(R\mathbf{b})=R(\mathbf{a}\times\mathbf{b})$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=19, )
rotation_arrow = FancyArrowPatch( (2.95, 3.30), (5.05, 3.30), connectionstyle="arc3,rad=-0.35", arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=15, linewidth=1.5, color=SLATE, zorder=3, ) ax.add_patch(rotation_arrow) ax.text(4, 3.84, r"$R$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=16, color=SLATE)
ax.text(2.05, 0.94, "Original configuration", ha="center", fontsize=12, weight="medium") ax.text(5.95, 0.94, "Rotated configuration", ha="center", fontsize=12, weight="medium") ax.text( 4, 0.40, r"Proper rotation: $R^{T}R=I$, $\det(R)=+1$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10.5, color=SLATE, ) ax.text(4, 0.16, "Schematic · dimensionless vectors · common orthographic view", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8.5, color=SLATE)
